none: PAS NLM-FC9AA2: NLM-FC9AA2: Roman Coin: Copy Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse: obliterated. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA E]XERC[ITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this tiny coin. Diameter: 11.8mm, Weight: 1.23gms
